name: sensor-site-report
instruction:
The sensor ingest pipeline in /app/pipeline is missing its aggregation step. Raw sensor dumps live in /data/readings (one JSON file per sensor).

Implement `build_site_summary(records)` in /app/pipeline/report.py and run the pipeline (`run.py`) so that it writes the report to /app/reports/site_summary.csv.

Report format:
- Header line exactly: site,sensors,readings,mean_value,max_value
- One row per site, sorted by site name (ascending).
- Only sensors whose status is "ok" count; sensors with any other status are ignored entirely.
- Readings whose value is null are ignored.
- sensors = number of ok sensors at the site; readings = number of non-null readings from those sensors.
- mean_value and max_value are computed over those readings and written with exactly 2 decimal places.

`build_site_summary` takes the list of parsed JSON records (as returned by loader.load_records) and returns the rows as a list of dicts with the keys site, sensors, readings, mean_value, max_value (mean_value and max_value as floats).
